name: Prism Medico & Pharmacy Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1985, Prism Medico & Pharmacy Ltd manufactures, trades, and distributes chemicals, medicines, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, and related products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
PMPL deals in chemicals, serums, chemical products, antibiotics, medicines, drugs, 
pharmaceuticals, pesticides, dyes, soaps, oils, perfumes, cosmetics, patent medicines, etc.
